verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a full public REST Search API with authentication headers, retry strategy guidance, and official client libraries in 9+ languages covered by an SLA, plus a CLI for scripting/CI workflows — all clearly AI-native-consumable interfaces. Additional evidence of llms.txt, agent skills, and MCP server support further reinforces machine/agent-driven access. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths) and independent hands-on confirmation of API usage by an AI agent.
